newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - COCOA TO TEST SUPPORT, MAY BREAK LOWER.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - COCOA TO TEST SUPPORT, MAY BREAK LOWER.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa is likely to test support today and could face a break lower, technical analysts said.
Traders called it due to open five stg lower.

"It should test the 965 stg low today," Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures, said. If that level were to break another band of resistance would form above it and the next potential step would be a test of 900 stg.
There was resistance above the market at 1,028 stg and 1,063 stg. "Only a break through there will relieve the strongly bearish influence on cocoa," Neil said.
New York cocoa futures ended sharply lower and near the bottom of the day's range for the third day in a row on Wednesday, pressured by continued speculative long liquidation, dealers said.
